company.name: PaySky
company.shortDescription: PaySky provides digital payment solutions enabling businesses to accept wallets, cards, bank accounts, and cash.
company.description: PaySky provides digital payment solutions for individuals, businesses, financial institutions, and governments. It offers services such as payment gateways, online and in-store payment acceptance tools, QR-based payments, and digital invoicing solutions that support e-commerce and merchant operations. The company also develops a digital financial ecosystem through its consumer-facing products, including a super app that enables payments, money transfers, and other financial services in a single platform. Its infrastructure is designed to support banks and payment providers with tools like tokenization, real-time payment processing, and payment-as-a-service platforms. Overall, Paysky focuses on building systems that support digital transactions and financial service delivery across multiple markets and sectors.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $7,000,000, or 97.22% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,691,187 to $34,620,948, a 20.47x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 45 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 50 (-6).
